messages:
Priya: FYI - Finsure wants a formal commitment: 7y retention, BYOK (EU KMS + optional HSM), per-tenant legal-hold toggles, and exportable immutable evidence for audits. Theyre asking for a commercial commitment in the next quarter. Can we triage scope and must-haves?
Devon (Sales): Theyre willing to pay for a dedicated package. Key ask: exports must be verifiable and complete for auditors.
Liam (Product): Quick clarifying Qs: 1) live search over 7y or export-only access? 2) HSM mandatory or optional?
Priya: They prefer live search for recent years (12-18 months) and export for older archives. HSM optional but preferred for top-tier contract.
Omar (SecOps): BYOK needs to support customer-supplied key references and server-side envelope encryption. If HSM is used we need to define key attestation flow and access audit. Also need KMS residency checks for EU keys.
Clara (Legal): For audit evidence we need chain-of-custody metadata (exporter identity, timestamps, checksum), signed manifest, and retention exception handling (legal holds). Also need deletion appeals process documented.
Ravi (SRE): Capacity note: 7y of logs at current ingest projection ~95-130TB depending on retention of embeddings & metadata. Indexing 7y for live search expensive. Suggest hybrid: hot index for last 12-18mo, warm/cold archive with export API for >18mo.
Liam (Product): Proposal for an MVP phased plan: Phase A (2 sprints): tenant retention config up to 2y, legal-hold flag, export API (ndjson) with signed manifest. Phase B (3-5 sprints): extend retention slider to 7y, hot/warm tiering, BYOK integration + HSM attestation, export orchestration for large datasets. Thoughts?
Devon (Sales): Phase A sounds sellable as a pilot. Finsure will push for Phase B but may accept staged contract. They want SLAs for export turnaround (target 72h for full export).
Omar (SecOps): 72h for ~100TB is borderline but doable with parallel chunked export and pre-validated keys. Need pre-flight checks (key access, permissions, egress limits). Also we need to capture detailed KMS audit logs for their SOC2.
Clara (Legal): Signed manifest should include: export_id, tenant_id, timestamp, signer_id, sha256 checksum per file, export_range, retention_policy_at_time, and legal_hold_flags. Well add exact wording for contract.
Priya: Example export request sketch (for feedback):
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "finsure",
  "export_id": "exp-2026-04-13-01",
  "range": {"from": "2019-01-01T00:00:00Z","to": "2026-04-01T23:59:59Z"},
  "format": "ndjson",
  "kms_key_ref": "eu-kms://projects/finsure/keys/key-1",
  "include_manifest": true,
  "preserve_originals": true
}
```
Ravi (SRE): Ops constraints: export must be resumable, rate-limited per-tenant, and generate manifest parts so auditors can validate partial transfers. Need worker pool sizing + ephemeral egress planning.
Omar (SecOps): BYOK design notes: 1) accept KMS key reference (no plaintext keys), 2) envelope encryption with platform data key encrypted by customer key, 3) attest KMS residency & rotation policy, 4) emit key-usage events to tenants audit stream.
Liam (Product): Action items Ill own: 1) draft PRD + phased scope doc (due Tue) 2) export manifest schema (w/ Clara) 3) SLA sketch for export turnaround.
Omar (SecOps): Ill spike KMS/HSM integrations and threat model (due Wed).
Ravi (SRE): Ill run a cost & ops capacity spike for 7y retention + export pipeline (due Wed).
Clara (Legal): Ill draft manifest contractual language and deletion appeal flow by Fri.
Devon (Sales): Ill get Finsure to confirm exact KMS vendor(s) and prioritize HSM requirement clarity.
engbot: Created ticket CUST-1599: "Finsure - retention & BYOK export ask" assigned to product-compliance squad.
Priya: Meeting proposed: Wed 11am sync to review spikes. If you cant make it, drop notes in CUST-1599. :calendar: :mag_right:
Liam (Product): One more thought  we should surface cost-band options in the PRD (self-serve vs dedicated vs on-prem private) so Sales can convert faster.
Priya: Agreed. Lets capture pricing tiers in the PRD. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
